chain.title: Wild at Heart
chain.desc: Wild Emmer and its sibling wild crops generate across the world and seed the whole farm.

chain.title: Barley There
chain.desc: Barley grows from seeds cut off a harvested stalk and feeds the soups and patties.

chain.title: Feeling Your Oats
chain.desc: Oat grows from seeds made with wheat seeds and bone meal, and bales for storage.

chain.title: Ear We Go
chain.desc: Corn is grown from kernels and roasts, grits or sides out from there.

chain.title: Layers of Meaning
chain.desc: Onions underpin the soups, the goulash and the pasta sauce.

chain.title: Well Rounded
chain.desc: Tomatoes come from wild tomato patches and make the farm's base tomato soup.

chain.title: Berry Good Year
chain.desc: Strawberries sweeten the oatmeal, the tea and Grandma's cake.

chain.title: Plow and Then
chain.desc: The Plow tills a wide swathe of farmland in one swing.

chain.title: Bowl Movement
chain.desc: The Crafting Bowl mixes butter, dough, salads and the pet foods.

chain.title: Grind Time
chain.desc: The Mincer turns wheat into flour, meat into mince, and dough into pasta.

chain.title: Flour Power
chain.desc: Wheat run through the Mincer becomes Flour, the base of all baking here.

chain.title: Yeast We Can Do
chain.desc: Sugar, water and wheat cook in the pot into Yeast.

chain.title: Pot Committed
chain.desc: The Cooking Pot, iron and a wooden shovel, handles the soups and the teas.

chain.title: Dough Re Mi
chain.desc: Flour, yeast and a water bottle come together in the crafting bowl as Dough.

chain.title: Stove It Up
chain.desc: The Stove is bricks, a campfire and iron, and it bakes and roasts the farm's big plates.

chain.title: Rise and Grind
chain.desc: Dough and water baked on the stove make a hearty Farmers Bread.

chain.title: Roast With the Most
chain.desc: The Roaster plates the mod's most involved multi-ingredient dinners.

chain.title: Better With Butter
chain.desc: A milk bucket worked in the crafting bowl gives Butter, required by nearly every roaster recipe.

chain.title: Grandma Knows Best
chain.desc: Dough, strawberries and sugar baked on the stove make Grandma's Strawberry Cake.

chain.title: The Most Important Meal
chain.desc: Bread, bacon with eggs and roasted corn assemble into the Farmers Breakfast, the full spread this farm was built for.

notes: Modid confirmed as farm_and_charm from assets/farm_and_charm/. Five custom recipe types map to five stations: farm_and_charm:mincer (flour, minced_beef, bacon, lamb_ham, chicken_parts, raw_pasta), :crafting_bowl (butter, dough, salads, pet food), :pot_cooking (soups and teas), :roaster (bowl dinners) and :stove (baked and roasted plates), plus :drying for fertilizer and bone meal. Butter is the real mid-game gate because every roaster recipe requires it. Note farm_and_charm:cooked_cod and farm_and_charm:cooked_salmon are the mod's own plated dishes, distinct from the vanilla ids of the same name. Dropped as unverifiable: cooking_saucepan, oat_bag, recipe_unlocker (model stems with no lang key and no recipe output; the jar's lang instead carries cooking_pan).
